problem:
In **ascending order**, rounded to two decimal places in radians, the solutions to the equation $3\operatorname{sin}⁡x=8\operatorname{cos}⁡x,$ for $0\le x<2\pi ,$ are

${x}_{1}≈$
 {{field-1}}$,\,{x}_{2}≈$ 
{{field-2}}.
worked_solution:
We divide both sides of the equation by $\operatorname{cos}⁡x$ and use the identity $\operatorname{tan}⁡x=\frac{\operatorname{sin}⁡x}{\operatorname{cos}⁡x}.$ 

$$
\begin{aligned}3\operatorname{sin}⁡x & =8\operatorname{cos}⁡x \\ \frac{3\operatorname{sin}⁡x}{\operatorname{cos}⁡x} & =\frac{8\operatorname{cos}⁡x}{\operatorname{cos}⁡x} \\ \frac{3\operatorname{sin}⁡x}{\operatorname{cos}⁡x} & =\frac{8\cancel{\operatorname{cos}⁡x}}{\cancel{\operatorname{cos}⁡x}} \\ 3\operatorname{tan}⁡x & =8\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we rearrange the equation and isolate $\operatorname{tan}⁡x:$

$$
\begin{aligned}3\operatorname{tan}⁡x & =8 \\ \operatorname{tan}⁡x & =\frac{8}{3} \\ \operatorname{tan}⁡x & =\frac{8}{3}\end{aligned}
$$

Next, we find the principal value:

$$
\begin{aligned}x & =\operatorname{arctan}⁡(\frac{8}{3})≈1.212\,03\end{aligned}
$$

rounded to $5$ decimal places. 

To find the other solution in the given interval, we add $\pi $ to the principal value. Hence,

$$
x≈1.212\,03+\pi ≈4.353\,62
$$

rounded to $5$ decimal places. 

So, in ascending order, rounded to two decimal places, the solutions are 

$$
{x}_{1}≈1.21,\,{x}_{2}≈4.35.
$$
